story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan loved Saturday mornings because the whole family stayed home together. While Dad was building a new bookshelf, he accidentally dropped the tiny instruction paper behind the heavy sofa.
[gesture:stretching] "I can't reach it," Dad said, stretching his long arm into the dark, narrow gap. [emotion:QT/sad] "Without those instructions, this shelf will never stand up straight.[emotion:QT/surprised] "
Ethan's eyes went wide. He ran to the kitchen and grabbed a flat wooden ruler. "Dad, my ruler is thin enough to slide under there," Ethan said carefully.
[gesture:think] Dad looked at the small ruler, then looked at Ethan. [emotion:QT/happy] "That's a really clever idea," Dad said. "You guide it left, and I'll hold the sofa steady.[gesture:nodding-yes] "
Together, they worked slowly. Ethan slid the ruler in, tilted it upward, and the paper came out.
[emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:embrace] Dad hugged Ethan tightly. "We made a great team today," Dad said. [emotion:QT/happy] and Ethan felt warm and proud inside.

paragraphs:
Ethan loved Saturday mornings because the whole family stayed home together. While Dad was building a new bookshelf, he accidentally dropped the tiny instruction paper behind the heavy sofa.
"I can't reach it," Dad said, stretching his long arm into the dark, narrow gap. "Without those instructions, this shelf will never stand up straight."
Ethan's eyes went wide. He ran to the kitchen and grabbed a flat wooden ruler. "Dad, my ruler is thin enough to slide under there," Ethan said carefully.
Dad looked at the small ruler, then looked at Ethan. "That's a really clever idea," Dad said. "You guide it left, and I'll hold the sofa steady."
Together, they worked slowly. Ethan slid the ruler in, tilted it upward, and the paper came out.
Dad hugged Ethan tightly. "We made a great team today," Dad said. and Ethan felt warm and proud inside.
